summary: This is a documentation page that displays all article series available on the site. It imports custom components to show statistics about the series and cards representing each series, along with a button to scroll back to the top, all organized under a centered heading with an introductory description.

explanations.3: This tells the documentation system not to render a table of contents on this page, since the page structure doesn't need one.
explanations.5: This specifies that 'christophe' is the author of this page, which metadata the site uses for attribution.
explanations.8: This imports a CSS file specifically for styling the series-related components on this page.
explanations.12: This disables a linting rule that would normally complain about markdown formatting, because this file mixes markdown with JSX components.
explanations.17: Instead of markdown heading syntax, this uses JSX to create an HTML heading with a CSS class for centering, which gives more control over the styling.
